title: How to make a cup of tea
intro: Press Play, or use Next and Back to go at your own pace.

scenes.title: A cup of tea
scenes.caption: Five easy steps to a good cup of tea.
scenes.say: Here's how to make a good cup of tea. It only takes five easy steps, and a few minutes.

scenes.title: You need
scenes.caption: A kettle, a mug, a tea bag and milk if you like it.
scenes.say: First, get your things ready. A kettle, a mug, a tea bag, and some milk if you like it.

scenes.title: Boil
scenes.caption: Boil fresh water in the kettle.
scenes.say: Fill the kettle with fresh water and boil it. Fresh water makes the tea taste better.

scenes.title: Brew
scenes.caption: Pour the water on the tea bag. Wait three minutes.
scenes.say: Put the tea bag in the mug and pour on the hot water. Then wait. Three minutes is about right.

scenes.title: Milk?
scenes.caption: Take the bag out. Add milk if you like it.
scenes.say: Take the tea bag out. Add a splash of milk if you like it, and give it a stir.

scenes.title: Enjoy
scenes.caption: That's it. Sit down and enjoy it.
scenes.say: And that's it. Sit down, take a sip, and enjoy your cup of tea.
